author: Zephyr I
title: Wider CNN test: Double-step+AttnPool (ConvLSTM 48ch), 60/120, ratio=0.5 — BASE_SEED=42
abstract: Test a slightly wider CNN (60/120) with stronger bottleneck (ratio=0.5) for compute-equalized double-step LN-ConvLSTM(48) + single-head AttnPool. Goal: lift capacity without sacrificing update throughput.
